judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a scene set on top of a solid-looking cloudscape that serves as the ground.
Include a hot air balloon with a large envelope featuring vertical red and white stripes and a brown wicker basket.
requirements.note: The envelope is orange-red with pale yellow vertical stripes and no white stripe, so it is not red-and-white striped.

requirements.text: The balloon's basket must be resting firmly on the surface of a large, flat-topped cloud.
requirements.note: The balloon floats in the upper-left sky with its basket in clear blue sky and a mooring rope hanging loose beneath it; it rests on no cloud.

requirements.text: Show ropes connecting the balloon's envelope to the basket.
Include four human figures styled as a family: two adults and two children.
Position one adult figure holding a corner of a red and white checkered picnic blanket, while one child figure holds the opposite corner, as if they are spreading it out together on the cloud.
requirements.note: The checkered blanket lies flat and untouched; no adult and child pair holds opposite corners.

requirements.text: Place an open picnic basket on a corner of the blanket that is already spread out.
requirements.note: The wicker basket stands on the cloud outside the blanket's left corner rather than on the blanket.

requirements.text: A thermos, a bunch of grapes, and a sandwich must be visible emerging from the open picnic basket.
requirements.note: The basket holds only a small yellow slab; no thermos, bunch of grapes or sandwich emerges from it.

requirements.text: Position the second adult and second child near the landed hot air balloon, with the adult pointing up at the balloon's envelope.
requirements.note: All four figures are grouped at the blanket far from the balloon, and no adult points up at the envelope.

requirements.text: The background must be a clear blue sky containing a bright yellow sun and two small, distant clouds.
requirements.note: Only one small distant cloud is drawn - a faint wisp beside the sun at about (860,155).
